name: Conforama Marketplace
description: Run your shop on the Conforama marketplace from an AI agent: orders, acceptance, tracking and shipping, incidents, offers with prices and stock, imports, messages, returns, invoices and transactions. The marketplace sells in France, Spain and Portugal; sign in with the shop API key from your Conforama seller back office.
instructions:
## Conforama Marketplace
Run your shop on the Conforama marketplace from an AI agent: orders, acceptance, tracking and shipping, incidents, offers with prices and stock, offer and product imports, messages with customers and Conforama, returns, order documents, invoices and transactions. The connector calls the Conforama seller platform at `https://conforama-prod.mirakl.net` with the API key of your shop, so it can see and do what your seller user can.

**Countries**: France, Spain and Portugal.

**Who can sell**: Conforama selects its sellers; contact it by e-mail (`marketplacebyconfo@conforama.fr`). The connector needs a seller account that Conforama has already opened.

**Setup (about 5 minutes)**
1. Sign in to the Conforama seller back office: `https://conforama-prod.mirakl.net/login`.
2. In the back office open your user name (top right) > **My user settings** > **API key** and click **Generate a new key** (or copy the existing key). Paste it into `CONFORAMA_API_KEY`. The key is sent as is in the `Authorization` header, without `Bearer`. Generating a new key invalidates the old one, so any other tool using it stops working.
3. Leave `CONFORAMA_SHOP_ID` empty. Only if your user manages several shops on Conforama, set `CONFORAMA_SHOP_ID` to the numeric id of the shop this connector should work on (shown on the dashboard of the back office next to **Identifier** or **Shop ID**, and returned as `shop_id` by `conforama_get_account`). Without it your default shop is used.
4. Install and run `conforama_get_account`: it returns the shop the key belongs to.

**Platform**: the Conforama seller back office runs on Mirakl software, so the operation codes in the tool descriptions (OR11, OF24 and so on) and the error names are those of that software.

**Where to start**: `conforama_get_account` shows the shop behind the key (id, name, state, currency and channels). For the daily work use `conforama_list_orders` with `order_state_codes=WAITING_ACCEPTANCE`, `conforama_list_offers` for prices and stock and `conforama_list_threads` for messages that wait for a reply.

**Products and competing offers**: `conforama_get_products` looks products up in the Conforama catalog by EAN or another reference and returns the marketplace product SKU; `conforama_list_product_offers` lists the offers of every shop for given products, best price first, at about 5 calls a minute.

**Order workflow**: a new order waits in `WAITING_ACCEPTANCE`. `conforama_accept_order` accepts (or refuses) every line; after the customer is debited the order moves to `SHIPPING`. Then `conforama_update_tracking` stores the carrier and tracking number (carrier codes come from `conforama_list_carriers`) and `conforama_ship_order` confirms the shipment (`SHIPPED`). Later states are `TO_COLLECT`, `RECEIVED`, `CLOSED`, `REFUSED` and `CANCELED`. Use `conforama_list_orders` with `order_state_codes=WAITING_ACCEPTANCE` for the daily to-do list and `has_incident=true` for open incidents; `conforama_resolve_incident` closes an incident on one order line once it is solved. Documents attached to orders (delivery notes, labels, customer invoices) are listed by `conforama_list_order_documents`.

**Writes: confirm first.** `conforama_accept_order`, `conforama_update_tracking`, `conforama_ship_order`, `conforama_resolve_incident`, `conforama_accept_return`, `conforama_receive_return`, `conforama_update_offers`, `conforama_reply_thread`, `conforama_create_order_thread` and `conforama_import_products` act on the live marketplace. Before each call, show the user what will change (order id and lines, tracking number, offer SKU with the old and new price or stock, the message text and recipients) and wait for a yes. Refusing an order line cancels it for good. No tool here refunds, cancels orders or moves money; do that in the back office. `conforama_import_offers` can delete offers (REPLACE mode deletes every offer missing from the file), so it is installed switched off.

**Updating offers (prices and stock)**: `conforama_update_offers` (OF24) replaces the whole offer. Every field you leave out is reset: a missing `quantity` becomes 0, a missing `discount` or `description` is deleted. Always read the offer first (`conforama_get_offer` or `conforama_list_offers` with `sku`) and send it back complete with only the intended change: `shop_sku`, `product_id` and `product_id_type` (from `product_references`), `state_code`, `price`, `quantity`, `leadtime_to_ship`, `logistic_class` (its code), `min_quantity_alert`, `description`, `discount`, `all_prices`, `available_started` / `available_ended` (read as `available_start_date` / `available_end_date`) and any `offer_additional_fields`. Leave `update_delete` empty or `update`. The call returns an `import_id`; the change is applied asynchronously, so check it with `conforama_get_offer_import` before reading the offer again. Condition codes for `state_code` come from `conforama_list_offer_conditions`, logistic class codes from `conforama_list_logistic_classes`.

**File imports**: `conforama_import_products` (P41) and `conforama_import_offers` (OF01) take the URL of a CSV, XLSX or XML file in the file format Conforama asks for; the connector downloads it and uploads it to Conforama. Track them with `conforama_list_product_imports` / `conforama_get_product_import` and `conforama_list_offer_imports` / `conforama_get_offer_import`.

**Returns**: `conforama_list_returns` (RT11) lists return requests. Where Conforama lets the shop decide, `conforama_accept_return` accepts or refuses one in `WAITING_ACCEPTANCE` and `conforama_receive_return` confirms the goods arrived. Refunds stay in the back office.

**Messages**: `conforama_list_threads` lists conversations (filter with `entity_type=MMP_ORDER` and `entity_id=<order id>` for one order; `entity_id` without `entity_type` is refused), `conforama_get_thread` reads one with its messages, `conforama_reply_thread` answers (recipient `CUSTOMER` or `OPERATOR`, which is Conforama) and `conforama_create_order_thread` opens a new conversation on an order. Reason codes for topics come from `conforama_list_reasons`; leave its `locale` empty unless you know the marketplace has that language (an inactive locale answers 400).

**Money**: `conforama_list_invoices` (IV01) lists the accounting documents Conforama issues to the shop and `conforama_list_transactions` (TL02) the transaction lines (sales, commissions, refunds, payouts). If Conforama uses Enhanced Seller Invoicing, IV01 returns no new documents; use `conforama_list_document_requests` (DR11) and the transactions then.

**Reference lists**: `conforama_list_channels` (country sites), `conforama_list_carriers`, `conforama_list_shipping_zones`, `conforama_list_shipping_methods` and `conforama_list_logistic_classes` change rarely; read them once per conversation.

**Pagination**: orders, offers, invoices and product imports page with `max` (at most 100) and `offset`. Threads, returns, transactions, document requests and offer imports return a `next_page_token`; pass it as `page_token` to get the next page (all other filters are then ignored) until it is missing.

**Dates** are ISO 8601, e.g. `2026-10-01T00:00:00Z`; answers are in UTC.

**Rate limits**: Each API has its own limit and Conforama can tighten them. Listing offers and orders is meant for interactive use, product and offer imports at most every 15 minutes, `conforama_get_account` and the reference lists about once a day. A 429 carries a `Retry-After` header with the seconds to wait; do not retry in a loop.

**Errors**: 401 means the key is wrong or was replaced by a newer one, 403 that your user lacks the right for this action, 404 that the order, offer or thread does not exist for this shop, 400 a wrong parameter or an order in the wrong state (the message names it, e.g. `ORDER_INVALID_STATE`).
prerequisites: An open seller account with Conforama and access to its seller back office to generate the shop API key. Conforama selects its sellers; contact it by e-mail (`marketplacebyconfo@conforama.fr`).

CONFORAMA_API_KEY.label: Shop API key
CONFORAMA_API_KEY.help: Conforama seller back office: your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key > Generate a new key. Generating a new key invalidates the previous one.
CONFORAMA_API_KEY.patternMessage: Paste the API key alone, without Bearer, quotes or spaces.

CONFORAMA_SHOP_ID.label: Shop ID (optional)
CONFORAMA_SHOP_ID.help: Only when your user manages several shops on Conforama: the numeric id of the shop to use. Leave empty to use your default shop.
CONFORAMA_SHOP_ID.patternMessage: The shop id is a number.

verifyHints.401: Conforama refused the API key. Check that CONFORAMA_API_KEY is the shop key from your Conforama seller back office, under your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key, and that it was not replaced by a newer key there.
verifyHints.403: The key works, but your user is not allowed to do this on the shop. Ask the shop administrator for the role, or set CONFORAMA_SHOP_ID to a shop you manage.
verifyHints.404: The Conforama seller platform did not find this for your shop. If every call answers this way, compare the address you sign in at with https://conforama-prod.mirakl.net: Conforama may have moved its seller back office.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Conforama is rate limiting this API for your shop. Wait for the seconds in the Retry-After header before trying again.

examples: Which orders are waiting for my acceptance?
Which customer messages still need a reply?
Show the price and stock of my offer for SKU 4711
needs: A Conforama seller account that is already open
A user who can open **My user settings** in the seller back office

steps.title: Open your Conforama seller account
steps.body: Sign in to the Conforama seller back office. Then open the menu below and create a key, or copy the one that is already there.

action.label: Open the Conforama seller back office

values.label: Menu
values.value: Your user name (top right) > My user settings > API key

values.label: Button
values.note: Replaces the previous key: anything else that uses the old key stops working.

problems.q: I do not see an API key tab
problems.a: API access is switched on per shop. Ask Conforama (your marketplace contact or the seller support) to enable it for your user.
The key belongs to your user, not to one shop. Note the id of the shop to use, shown on the dashboard next to **Identifier** or **Shop ID**: you enter it in the next step.

problems.q: I do not have a seller account yet
problems.a: Conforama selects its sellers; contact it by e-mail (`marketplacebyconfo@conforama.fr`).

steps.title: Paste the key
steps.body: Paste the key alone, without `Bearer`, quotes or spaces. Leave the shop ID empty unless your user manages several shops.

problems.a: Copy it again from the back office. If a newer key was generated, only the newest one works.

problems.q: Which shop ID do I enter?
problems.a: The numeric id on the dashboard of the back office, next to **Identifier** or **Shop ID**. With a single shop, leave the field empty. To work on several shops, set the connector up once per shop.

tools.name: conforama_get_account
tools.description: Read the shop behind the API key on this marketplace (A01): shop id and name, state, channels, currency, grade and approval rate, contact and shipping settings. The quickest check that the key works. Meant to be called about once a day, not on every question.

tools.name: conforama_list_orders
tools.description: List orders (OR11) with their lines, customer, shipping address, prices, state and incidents. Filter by state (e.g. WAITING_ACCEPTANCE for orders to accept, SHIPPING for orders to ship), by creation or update date, by order id or channel. Pages with max (at most 100) and offset.

order_state_codes.description: Comma-separated order states: STAGING, WAITING_ACCEPTANCE, WAITING_DEBIT, WAITING_DEBIT_PAYMENT, SHIPPING, SHIPPED, TO_COLLECT, RECEIVED, CLOSED, REFUSED, CANCELED.

start_date.description: Orders created at or after this time, ISO 8601 (e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

end_date.description: Orders created before this time, ISO 8601.

start_update_date.description: Orders updated at or after this time, ISO 8601. Best filter for polling changes.

end_update_date.description: Orders updated before this time, ISO 8601.

has_incident.description: true: only orders with an open incident; false: only orders without one.

customer_debited.description: true: only orders the customer has paid.

channel_codes.description: Comma-separated sales channel codes (country sites of the marketplace).

order_references_for_seller.description: Comma-separated order references you set for yourself.

offset.description: Number of orders to skip, for paging.

order.description: Sort direction by creation date (default asc). desc lists the newest first.

tools.name: conforama_list_offers
tools.description: List the shop's offers (OF21): SKU, product, price and discount, all channel prices, quantity in stock, condition, lead time and whether the offer is active (with the inactivity reasons). Filter by sku or product. Pages with max (at most 100) and offset.

pricing_channel_code.description: Channel whose prices should be returned as the applicable price.

offset.description: Number of offers to skip, for paging.

tools.name: conforama_get_offer
tools.description: Read one offer in full by its offer id (OF22): every price field, discount, quantity, condition, logistic class, lead time and custom fields. Read it before conforama_update_offers, which needs the complete offer.

offer_id.description: Offer id on the marketplace (offer_id in conforama_list_offers), not your SKU.

tools.name: conforama_list_offer_conditions
tools.description: List the offer conditions (OF61) the marketplace accepts, e.g. new or used, with the code to put in state_code when updating offers.

tools.name: conforama_list_offer_imports
tools.description: List offer imports and updates (OF04), from files and from conforama_update_offers: status (WAITING, RUNNING, COMPLETE, FAILED), lines read, in success and in error, offers inserted, updated and deleted. Newest first. Pass next_page_token back as page_token for more.

start_date.description: Imports created at or after this time, ISO 8601.

end_date.description: Imports created before this time, ISO 8601.

page_token.description: next_page_token from the previous page. All other filters are then ignored.

tools.name: conforama_get_offer_import
tools.description: Read the status of one offer import or offer update (OF02) by its import_id, as returned by conforama_update_offers or conforama_import_offers: status, lines in success and in error, offers inserted, updated and deleted, and whether an error report exists.

import_id.description: The import_id returned by conforama_update_offers or conforama_import_offers.

tools.name: conforama_list_product_imports
tools.description: List product imports (P51) with their status (WAITING, RUNNING, SENT, COMPLETE, FAILED, CANCELLED), the transformation counts and the integration result (products synchronized, rejected, invalid). Pages with max and offset.

last_request_date.description: Only imports that changed since this time, ISO 8601. Without it every product import is returned.

offset.description: Number of imports to skip, for paging.

order.description: Sort direction by creation date (default asc). desc lists the newest first.

tools.name: conforama_get_product_import
tools.description: Read the status of one product import (P42) by its import_id: import status, reason, transformation counts and the integration details (synchronized, rejected, invalid, wrong identifiers).

tools.name: conforama_get_products
tools.description: Look up products in the marketplace catalog by their identifiers (P31), e.g. EAN, and get the marketplace product SKU, title and category. Up to 100 products per call.

product_references.description: Comma-separated <type>|<value> pairs, e.g. EAN|3276000000000,EAN|4000000000000. The types are the product references Conforama uses (EAN, UPC...); SKU and SHOP_SKU are not accepted.

tools.name: conforama_list_product_offers
tools.description: List the offers of every shop for given products (P11), sorted by best price, to compare your price with the competition. Give product_ids or product_references (up to 100). The limit is about 5 calls a minute.

all_offers.description: true to include inactive offers (default: active offers only).

channel_codes.description: Comma-separated channel codes: only offers sold on these channels.

offset.description: Number of products to skip, for paging.

tools.name: conforama_list_threads
tools.description: List message threads (M11) with customers and Conforama: topic, linked order or offer, participants, last message date and since when a shop reply is needed. Filter with entity_type and entity_id for one order. Pass next_page_token back as page_token for more.

entity_type.description: Only threads on this kind of entity: MMP_ORDER (orders), MMP_OFFER (offers), SELLER_OPERATOR (with Conforama).

entity_id.description: Comma-separated entity ids, e.g. order ids. Needs entity_type.

updated_since.description: Only threads changed at or after this time, ISO 8601.

with_messages.description: true to include the messages (the last 100 of each thread).

page_token.description: next_page_token from the previous page. All other filters are then ignored.

tools.name: conforama_get_thread
tools.description: Read one message thread (M10) with all its messages, senders, recipients, attachments and the linked order or offer.

tools.name: conforama_list_returns
tools.description: List return requests (RT11) with their state, return lines, reason, RMA, tracking and the linked order. Filter by state, order or date. Pass next_page_token back as page_token for more.

return_state.description: Only returns in this state: WAITING_ACCEPTANCE, IN_PROGRESS, REFUSED, RECEIVED, NO_RECEPTION, CLOSED or CANCELED.

order_commercial_id.description: Only returns of this order (commercial id).

return_creation_date_from.description: Returns created after this time, ISO 8601.

return_creation_date_to.description: Returns created before this time, ISO 8601.

return_last_updated_from.description: Returns updated after this time, ISO 8601.

page_token.description: next_page_token from the previous page. All other filters are then ignored.

tools.name: conforama_list_reasons
tools.description: List the marketplace's reason codes (RE01): incident, cancellation, refund and message reasons, with their labels and whether the shop may use them. Use a code as the topic of a message thread.

locale.description: Language of the labels, e.g. fr_FR. Only a locale active on this marketplace works (others answer 400); leave empty for the default.

tools.name: conforama_list_carriers
tools.description: List the carriers the marketplace knows (SH21) with their code, label and tracking URL. Use the code as carrier_code in conforama_update_tracking.

tools.name: conforama_list_invoices
tools.description: List the accounting documents Conforama issues to the shop (IV01): invoices and credit notes with period, totals with and without tax, commission details, payment state and due date. Pages with max and offset.

start_date.description: Documents created at or after this time, ISO 8601.

end_date.description: Documents created before this time, ISO 8601.

type.description: Document type. The default is AUTO_INVOICE (the regular billing-cycle invoices); ALL includes manual invoices and credits.

payment_status.description: Only documents in this payment state.

offset.description: Number of documents to skip, for paging.

tools.name: conforama_list_transactions
tools.description: List the shop's transaction lines (TL02): order amounts, shipping, commissions, refunds, manual credits and payouts, with amount, type, payment state, balance and the accounting document they belong to. Filter by date, type or order. Pass next_page_token back as page_token for more.

date_created_from.description: Lines created at or after this time, ISO 8601.

date_created_to.description: Lines created before this time, ISO 8601.

transaction_date_from.description: Lines whose transaction date is at or after this time, ISO 8601.

transaction_date_to.description: Lines whose transaction date is before this time, ISO 8601.

last_updated_from.description: Lines updated at or after this time, ISO 8601.

transaction_type.description: Only this transaction type, e.g. ORDER_AMOUNT, ORDER_SHIPPING_AMOUNT, COMMISSION_FEE, REFUND_ORDER_AMOUNT, PAYMENT.

payment_state.description: Only lines in this payment state: PENDING, PAYABLE, PAID, NOT_APPLICABLE or RESERVE.

accounting_document_number.description: Only lines of this accounting document (invoice number).

page_token.description: next_page_token from the previous page. All other filters are then ignored.

tools.name: conforama_list_document_requests
tools.description: List accounting document requests (DR11), used when Conforama runs Enhanced Seller Invoicing: invoices and credit notes that Conforama or the shop issues, with state, type, issuer, document number, amounts and payment state. Filter by date, state, type or document number. Pass next_page_token back as page_token for more.

state.description: Only requests in this state. TO_PROCESS are documents the shop still has to issue.

type.description: Only invoices or only credit notes.

issuer_type.description: Only documents issued by Conforama (OPERATOR), or by the shop (SHOP).

document_number.description: Only the request with this accounting document number.

date_created_from.description: Requests created after this time, ISO 8601.

date_created_to.description: Requests created before this time, ISO 8601.

issue_date_from.description: Requests issued after this time, ISO 8601.

issue_date_to.description: Requests issued before this time, ISO 8601.

payment_state.description: Only paid or pending documents (purchase order and fee requests only).

page_token.description: next_page_token from the previous page. All other filters are then ignored.

tools.name: conforama_list_order_documents
tools.description: List the documents attached to one or more orders (OR72): delivery notes, shipping labels, customer invoices and other files, with id, file name, type code and upload date. Download links are not part of this tool; open the file in the back office.

tools.name: conforama_list_channels
tools.description: List the marketplace's sales channels (CH11), usually one per country site, with code and label. Use the codes as channel_codes in conforama_list_orders and conforama_list_product_offers. Changes rarely: call it once, not on every question.

tools.name: conforama_list_shipping_zones
tools.description: List the active shipping zones of the marketplace (SH11) with code and label, e.g. mainland France or Corsica. Changes rarely: call it once, not on every question.

tools.name: conforama_list_shipping_methods
tools.description: List the active shipping methods of the marketplace (SH12), e.g. standard, express or pick-up, with code, label, whether a tracking number is mandatory and whether it is click and collect. The code appears as shipping_type_code on orders. Changes rarely: call it once, not on every question.

tools.name: conforama_list_logistic_classes
tools.description: List the marketplace's logistic classes (SH31), the size or weight bands that decide shipping prices, with code and label. Use the code as logistic_class in conforama_update_offers. Changes rarely: call it once, not on every question.

tools.name: conforama_accept_order
tools.description: Accept or refuse the lines of an order waiting for acceptance (OR21). Every line of the order must be listed. Refusing a line cancels it for good. Acts on the live marketplace: name the order and the decision per line and get a yes from the user first.

order_lines.description: One entry per order line: {"id": "<order_line_id>", "accepted": true}. Use accepted false only when the user explicitly wants to refuse that line.

accepted.description: true to accept, false to refuse (cancels the line).

tools.name: conforama_update_tracking
tools.description: Set the carrier and tracking number of an order (OR23). Give carrier_code from conforama_list_carriers, or carrier_name with carrier_url for a carrier the marketplace does not know. Acts on the live marketplace and is shown to the customer: name the order and the tracking data and get a yes from the user first.

carrier_name.description: Carrier name, for a carrier that is not in conforama_list_carriers.

carrier_url.description: Full tracking URL, for a carrier that is not in conforama_list_carriers.

carrier_standard_code.description: Standard carrier code, when the marketplace uses them.

tools.name: conforama_ship_order
tools.description: Confirm that an order in SHIPPING has been shipped (OR24); it moves to SHIPPED and the customer is notified. Set the tracking first with conforama_update_tracking. Cannot be undone: name the order and get a yes from the user first.

tools.name: conforama_update_offers
tools.description: Create or update offers, including price and stock (OF24). Replaces each offer completely: every field left out is reset (a missing quantity becomes 0), so read the offer first and send it back whole with only the intended change. Returns an import_id to check with conforama_get_offer_import. Acts on the live marketplace: list each SKU with the old and new values and get a yes from the user first.

offers.description: Offers to create or update. Each needs shop_sku, state_code and price; product_id and product_id_type are required when the offer is new. Send every field the offer has (quantity, leadtime_to_ship, logistic_class, description, discount, all_prices, min_quantity_alert, available_started, available_ended, offer_additional_fields...), otherwise it is reset. Leave update_delete empty or set it to update.

product_id_type.description: Type of product_id, e.g. EAN, or SHOP_SKU / SKU as the marketplace allows.

quantity.description: Stock available. If left out it is set to 0.

discount.description: Discount {price, start_date, end_date}; left out means deleted.

all_prices.description: Channel and volume prices, as read from the offer.

update_delete.description: Leave empty or update. Deleting offers is not done with this tool.

tools.name: conforama_reply_thread
tools.description: Reply in a message thread (M12) to the customer or Conforama. The message is delivered at once and cannot be taken back: show the user the text and the recipients and get a yes from the user first.

to.description: Recipients, e.g. [{"type": "CUSTOMER"}] or [{"type": "OPERATOR"}]. type is CUSTOMER, OPERATOR (Conforama) or SHOP; add id only to pick one participant of the thread.

topic.description: Optional new topic: {"type": "FREE_TEXT", "value": "..."} or {"type": "REASON_CODE", "value": "<code from conforama_list_reasons>"}.

tools.name: conforama_create_order_thread
tools.description: Start a new message thread on an order (OR43) with the customer, Conforama or both. The message is delivered at once: show the user the text, topic and recipients and get a yes from the user first.

topic_type.description: FREE_TEXT for your own subject, REASON_CODE for a code from conforama_list_reasons.

topic_value.description: The subject text, or the reason code.

tools.name: conforama_resolve_incident
tools.description: Mark the open incident on one order line as resolved (OR64), once the customer's problem is solved. reason_code must be an INCIDENT_CLOSE reason from conforama_list_reasons. Closes the incident on the live marketplace: name the order, the line and the reason and get a yes from the user first.

order_line_id.description: Order line id with the open incident, e.g. 1234567-A-1 (order_line_id in conforama_list_orders).

reason_code.description: Code of an INCIDENT_CLOSE reason from conforama_list_reasons.

tools.name: conforama_accept_return
tools.description: Accept or refuse a return request in WAITING_ACCEPTANCE (RT21). Only when Conforama handles returns in the seller back office and leaves the decision to the shop. Refusing needs a rejection_reason_code. This only decides the request; refunds are not made by this tool. Acts on the live marketplace: name the return, the decision and the reason and get a yes from the user first.

accepted.description: true accepts the return, false refuses it.

rejection_reason_code.description: Required when accepted is false: not eligible, no return needed, or return window closed.

tools.name: conforama_receive_return
tools.description: Confirm that the goods of an accepted return arrived at your warehouse (RT25). The return moves to RECEIVED. Acts on the live marketplace: name the return and get a yes from the user first.

tools.name: conforama_import_products
tools.description: Send a product file to the marketplace (P41) to create or enrich products in its catalog. file_url is the address of a CSV, XLSX or XML file in the product file format Conforama asks for; the connector downloads it (up to 10 MB) and uploads it. Returns an import_id to follow with conforama_get_product_import. The limit is one import every 15 minutes. Changes the marketplace catalog: describe the file and get a yes from the user first.

file_url.description: Public https URL of the product file (CSV, XLSX or XML).

operator_format.description: true when the file is already in the product format Conforama defines.

tools.name: conforama_import_offers
tools.description: Import an offer file (OF01) to create, update or delete offers in bulk. REPLACE mode deletes every offer that is not in the file, and NORMAL mode deletes the lines marked delete. file_url is the address of a CSV, XLSX or XML file in the offer file format Conforama asks for; the connector downloads it (up to 10 MB) and uploads it. Returns an import_id to follow with conforama_get_offer_import. Installed switched off; describe the file and the mode and get a yes from the user first.

file_url.description: Public https URL of the offer file.

import_mode.description: NORMAL creates, updates or deletes the offers in the file. REPLACE also deletes every offer missing from it.

with_products.description: true when the file also carries product data.
